question.text: The industrial activity held least responsible for global warming is :

options.text: Electricity generation in thermal power plants.

solution.text: In urea industry, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>,<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo> </mo><msub><mi>CO</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math>  and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></math> are consumed and no greenhouse gases are emitted. So, it is least resposible for global warming.
